Verified in `run-integration.sh:12-17` and extension `README.md:33-36`.

- The daemon pins its **startup** env: print-mode clients attach to an already-running shared daemon (existing pipe/worker identity), so a client-side `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` export is never seen — the daemon resolves the home it loaded at spawn (default `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\The-Second-Brain`).
- Integration runs must therefore pass a dedicated `--daemon-socket <per-run pipe>` so a fresh daemon spawns and inherits the exported `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME`/`SECOND_BRAIN_OBSERVABILITY`, then `daemon shutdown --daemon-socket <pipe>`; production users must set `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` before starting `prime-agent`.
